<tabber>
|-| Pan & Shovel Progression =

== Pan Progression ==
Pan quality generally corresponds to price - more expensive means better - so progression is pretty much identical to the order they're listed on the [[Pans|pans page]]. However, '''you are not required to buy every pan'''. If you can afford to buy a pan a couple of rows down from your current pan, it's fine to skip the intervening one(s). 
* If getting to the pan requires unlocking something, and you're having trouble obtaining the ore needed - e.g. [[Starshine]] for [[Worldshaker]] or [[Flarebloom]] for [[Fossilized Pan]] - ''just skip it''.

== Shovel Progression == 
Shovels are similar: more expensive means better, so progression is in the order they're listed on the [[Shovels|shovels page]], and you are not required to buy every shovel.
* As with pans, if you're having trouble getting a particular ore - for example, [[Starshine]] for [[Earthbreaker]] or [[Flarebloom]] for [[Fossilized Shovel]] - just skip those shovels.

However, there are some shovels that are '''required for progression''':
* The [[Dragonflame Shovel]] is needed for unlocking the [[Snowy Mountain]] - talk to the [[Arctic Traveler]] at {{Caldera Park}}.
* Both the Dragonflame Shovel and [[Icebreaker]] are needed for opening the door between {{Azuralite Oasis}} and {{Overgrown Grotto}}.
* The [[Lifetouched Shovel]] is needed for cutting the vines at the entrance to {{Rotwood Swamp}}.

== Tips ==
In general, you should buy the next pan before you buy the next shovel, with two exceptions:
# The next shovel is needed for unlocking the next area.
# Your current shovel is not tough enough for the area you just unlocked.


|-| Best Farming Places =
This guide highlights the '''best farming spots''' for money, modifiers, and late-game ores.

== The Void (if opened) ==
[[File:TheVoid.png|center|700px]]
* Special location: It can be opened with a [[Void Shard]] for 30 minutes with the portal appearing in {{Fortune River}}. 
* Best for: money, because of the '''[[Modifiers#Voidtorn|Voidtorn]] modifier multiplier''' (11x).  
* Only farm here when it’s available; otherwise, use the spots below.

== Infernal Heart ==
[[File:Infernal Heart.png|center|700px]]
* Endgame, extremely profitable.  
* Best for: '''highest-value ores''', rare exotic.  
* Needs strong '''Pan & Shovel''' sets.

== Magma Furnace ==
[[File:Magma Furnace SWP.png|center|700px]]
* Great '''modifier''' and '''size''' density.  
* Ideal mid→late-game farm; source of '''Dragonflame tools'''.

== Azuralite Oasis / Frozen Peak ==
[[File:Azuralite Oasis.png|center|700px]]
[[File:Frozen Peak.png|center|700px]]
* '''Azuralite Oasis''' — recommended midgame starter farm.  
* '''Frozen Peak''' — endgame route; source of '''Frostbite tools'''.
